headline: NQ is +0.9% near its overnight high after Monday's −1.4% NDX close at the lows, but Apple and Palantir are sliding on earnings and it's Election Day. Stand aside at the open; go LONG above 28,424, SHORT below Monday's 28,127.5 settle.
session_note: Cash open 9:30 AM ET (10:30 AM Atlantic) · morning window · JOLTS + factory orders 10:00 AM ET · no Fed speakers · AMD after close · midterm results tonight

flip.long: LONG on a break and hold of the overnight high 28,424 (≈ NDX 28,286), meaning the chip-led bounce is overpowering Apple's drag. Stronger if the 10-year stays under 4.90% after JOLTS.
flip.short: SHORT if NQ loses Monday's settle 28,127.5 (≈ NDX 27,990, Monday's close and low), meaning the gap filled and the selling is back. Stronger below the overnight low 28,038 (≈ NDX 27,900).

thesis: No clear edge at the open, so stand aside. Monday's long call failed: the **NDX fell 1.39% to 27,989.82 and closed at its low** (range 27,967.44–28,753.39) as chips sold off again, and the index is now in a technical correction [1,4]. **NQ is +251 pts / +0.89% at 28,378.50 (8:37 AM ET)**, near the top of a 28,038.25–28,423.75 overnight range, as dip buyers go back into chips (MU, INTC, SNDK +3% or more; NVDA +1.4%) [2,4]. On Monday's ~138-pt futures premium, that implies a cash open near ~28,241 [1,2]. But the heaviest stocks are going the other way: **Apple is down ~4–6% premarket** on a 45–46% gross-margin guide hit by memory costs, Palantir is down ~6–9% on slowing contract growth, and MSFT and AMD are lower ahead of AMD's report tonight [3,5]. Macro is mixed to slightly helpful: oil swung up overnight on a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, but WTI is now −2% at ~$94.6 and Brent −2.5% at ~$102.2; the 10-year is flat at ~4.89%, the dollar is flat at ~101.78, and VIX is lower at ~20.5 [6,9]. December hike odds are ~75% (CME FedWatch) [8]. It's Election Day: expect light volume and tight ranges, with the real move likely once results come in tonight [4,5]. So **stand aside unless NQ clears 28,424 (long) or loses 28,127.5 (short)**, and keep size small either way, with JOLTS at 10:00.

bullets.label: The gap is up, but it's into a weak close.
bullets.text: NQ is +0.89% at 28,378.50, near its 28,423.75 overnight high [2]. But Monday's NDX closed at its 27,967–27,990 low after failing at 28,753, and the index is in a technical correction [1,4]. A ~28,241 implied open is still well inside Monday's range. That's an estimate, not a quote.

bullets.label: Megacaps are split.
bullets.text: Chips are bouncing (MU, INTC, SNDK +3% or more; NVDA +1.4%) and AMZN is +3.5% [2,4]. But Apple is −4–6% on a weak margin guide, Palantir −6–9% on slowing contract value growth, and MSFT −3% [3,5]. Apple's weight in the NDX makes it a real drag on the cash open.

bullets.label: Macro is neutral to slightly helpful.
bullets.text: Oil is lower again after an overnight jump on the Qeshm strike, the 10-year is flat at ~4.89%, and VIX is −3% [6,9]. December hike odds are ~75% [8].

bullets.label: Election Day keeps ranges tight.
bullets.text: Barron's expects light volume, tight ranges and defensive rotation, with the big move likely after results come in tonight and Wednesday [4]. JOLTS and factory orders hit at 10:00 AM ET; there are no Fed speakers [7].

bullets.label: Bull case:
bullets.text: Futures have held most of their gains all night, chips are being bought after a two-day selloff, oil is falling and VIX is easing [2,4,9]. A cash open that holds above the overnight high could squeeze toward Monday's 28,753 high.

bullets.label: Bear case:
bullets.text: Monday's bounce failed hard and closed at the low, so dip buyers have been trapped twice [1]. Apple and Palantir are confirming worries about AI costs and slowing growth [3,5]. Oil can jump again on Iran headlines, and a strong JOLTS could push yields and hike odds higher [6,8]. Election de-risking adds to selling pressure into the close.

bullets.label: Flip to LONG:
bullets.text: NQ breaks and holds above the overnight high 28,423.75 (≈ NDX 28,286) in the first 30 minutes, ideally with the 10-year under 4.90% after JOLTS and Apple stabilizing.

bullets.label: Flip to SHORT:
bullets.text: NQ loses Monday's settle 28,127.50 (≈ NDX 27,990), filling the gap. Stronger below the overnight low 28,038.25 (≈ NDX 27,900), a new low for the selloff.

bullets.label: Stay STAND ASIDE:
bullets.text: NQ chops between 28,127.5 and 28,424, which is likely on Election Day. Cut size into the close: midterm results and AMD earnings come after the bell.

bullets.label: Wildcards:
bullets.text: JOLTS and factory orders at 10:00 AM ET, US–Iran headlines and oil, AMD after the close, and early election results tonight [4,6,7].
